messages:
sophia: Quick heads-up — planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow at 18:00 UTC. Please confirm if your subsystems have backport PRs ready or if you need a soft extension. cc @release-owners

mike: I have two backports queued (perf and config). CI flaky on one, retrying now. If CI green by 16:30 UTC we’re good.

rachel: We need to confirm changelog entries for the telemetry changes — I’ll add the bullets by EOD. Also flagging one migration note that might need doc review.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release branch creation window opens at 18:00 UTC. Auto-checklist: tests-green, changelog-present, backport-labels.

alex: FYI I’ve got a cherry-pick that touches infra; it needs eng-sre signoff. @mike can you look after the config conflict?

liz: Small ask: can we hold the cut by 30 mins if doc review slips? Not a hard blocker but would be helpful.

sophia: OK — contingency: if any backport PRs are still failing CI at 18:00 we’ll postpone branch cut by 30m and open a short triage thread. Please add label `release/1.16-backport` to any PRs that should be included.

mike: Adding label now. If the retry fails I’ll ping here with the PR link.

rachel: Changelog bullets added and linked in PR (see PR #4521). Doc review pinged @liz.

alex: infra cherry-pick is ready; dropped a note in the PR about the dependency bump. Eng-sre can merge after signoff.

sophia: Great — two operational reminders before the cut:
1) Branch create command we’ll run: `git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main && git push origin release/1.16`
2) If you need a post-cut hotfix, open PR against release/1.16 and add `cherry-pick-request` label.

liz: sounds good. I might need the 30m bump depending on docs review but will update by 16:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: CI status: perf-backport (#4509): running, infra-cherry (#4518): passed, telemetry-changelog (#4521): passed.

sophia: Thanks all — will do final check at 17:30 UTC and post final go/no-go. If you don’t hear from me assume cut proceeds at 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

mike: Affirmative.

rachel: Thanks, team.

alex: thumbs up from me too.

sophia: (after 17:30) quick update — perf-backport CI still flaky; extending window to 18:30 and opening a short triage thread at #eng-releases if it’s not green by then.

mike: Understood — I’ll keep pushing fixes.

deploy-bot: Follow-up checklist created: /release/1.16/pre-cut-triage (automated).
